Export a Docker image from Packer build

Tag Docker image with custom version
Create a vSphere/VMware builder in Packer
output: echo 'source "vsphere-iso" "ubuntu" { vcenter_server = var.vcenter_server username = var.vcenter_user password = var.vcenter_password datacenter = "DC1" cluster = "Cluster1" vm_name = "ubuntu-22.04-{{timestamp}}" guest_os_type = "ubuntu64Guest" }' > vsphere.pkr.hcl

instruction: Create a QEMU builder for local VM images
output: echo 'source "qemu" "ubuntu" { iso_url = "https://releases.ubuntu.com/22.04/ubuntu-22.04.3-live-server-amd64.iso" iso_checksum = "sha256:xxxxx" output_directory = "output/qemu" ssh_username = "ubuntu" memory = 2048 }' > qemu.pkr.hcl

instruction: Create a VirtualBox builder
output: echo 'source "virtualbox-iso" "ubuntu" { iso_url = "https://releases.ubuntu.com/22.04/ubuntu-22.04.3-live-server-amd64.iso" iso_checksum = "sha256:xxxxx" ssh_username = "ubuntu" guest_additions_mode = "disable" }' > vbox.pkr.hcl

instruction: Create a Google Cloud builder in Packer
output: echo 'source "googlecompute" "ubuntu" { project_id = var.gcp_project zone = "us-central1-a" machine_type = "e2-micro" source_image_family = "ubuntu-2204-lts" ssh_username = "ubuntu" }' > gcp.pkr.hcl

instruction: Create an Azure builder in Packer
output: echo 'source "azure-arm" "ubuntu" { client_id = var.arm_client_id client_secret = var.arm_client_secret subscription_id = var.arm_subscription_id managed_image_resource_group_name = "packer-images" managed_image_name = "ubuntu-22.04-{{timestamp}}" os_type = "Linux" image_publisher = "Canonical" image_offer = "UbuntuServer" image_sku = "22.04-LTS" }' > azure.pkr.hcl

instruction: Create a DigitalOcean builder in Packer
output: echo 'source "digitalocean" "ubuntu" { api_token = var.do_token image = "ubuntu-22-04-x64" region = "nyc3" size = "s-1vcpu-1gb" ssh_username = "root" }' > do.pkr.hcl

instruction: Create an OpenStack builder in Packer
output: echo 'source "openstack" "ubuntu" { identity_endpoint = var.os_auth_url tenant_name = var.os_tenant_name username = var.os_username password = var.os_password region = "RegionOne" image_name = "Ubuntu 22.04" flavor = "m1.small" ssh_username = "ubuntu" }' > openstack.pkr.hcl

instruction: Create a Null builder for testing
Build a multi-source template (same image to multiple clouds)
output: echo 'build { sources = ["source.amazon-ebs.ubuntu", "source.googlecompute.ubuntu"] provisioner "shell" { inline = ["echo built"] } }' > multi-cloud.pkr.hcl
